column1: # Slice 301 probes on the published tuple 300 (CALLABLE-PLACE-TYPED-RECEPTION; Codex's review of 300, item 4): a typed value
# bound by name to a formal of another number type of the callable selected at run time, the order of the effects, the
# status of the bound call and of a callee in a mutable callable place, a bound call that does not run, the receiver's own
# refusal.  p301b's expected 12 is the order 1233 (both actuals, then both receptions); 13 would be 1323.
